appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Global Energy Consumption by Source'
Four colored segments representing energy sources: Nuclear (orange-red), Hydroelectric (red), Fossil Fuels (yellow), Renewables (orange)

public_definitions: Use the dashboard to determine which energy source is the largest category in global energy consumption for this routing decision.
Review the global energy mix dashboard, identify the largest global energy consumption source category, then route that source record to priority source monitoring for this reporting cycle.
